table.ruleA: Add the cycle's feed charge to every chamber; holding limit not enforced.
table.ruleB: Add row k of the input table to every x_i; box bound not enforced.

table.ruleA: Sequential in order 1..6 on already-updated masses; if mass > holding limit (strictly above), excess goes to chamber n+1 and the mass is set to the limit; excess from chamber 6 goes to the waste tally.
table.ruleB: Sequential in order 1..6 on already-updated values; if x_i > c_i (strictly above), violation goes to component i+1 and x_i is set to c_i; violation from component 6 goes to s.

table.ruleA: Read after step 2. LARVAL and mass >= pupation mark becomes PUPAL; PUPAL and mass <= return mark becomes LARVAL; otherwise no change; at most one change per cycle; record changes.
table.ruleB: Read after Step 2. INACTIVE and x_i >= u_i becomes ACTIVE; ACTIVE and x_i <= d_i becomes INACTIVE; otherwise no change; at most one change per iteration; record changes.

table.ruleA: Amounts computed simultaneously from start-of-step mass with post-step-3 stage: LARVAL floor(m/4), PUPAL floor(m/2). Each chamber loses its amount; LARVAL amount goes to the waste tally; PUPAL amount goes to the PREVIOUS chamber n-1; a PUPAL chamber 1 amount goes to waste.
table.ruleB: Amounts computed simultaneously from start-of-step values with post-Step-3 flags: INACTIVE floor(x/4), ACTIVE floor(x/2). Each component loses its amount; INACTIVE amount goes to s; ACTIVE amount goes to the NEXT component i+1; an ACTIVE component 6 amount goes to s.
table.difference: Where the high-state transfer goes. A sends a PUPAL chamber's half to chamber n-1 (upstream), with chamber 1's half going to waste. B sends an ACTIVE component's half to component i+1 (downstream), with component 6's half going to s. Rounding, simultaneity and which state reading is used are the same.

table.ruleA: Sum all six masses after step 4; if the total is strictly more than 38 (38 does not trigger), every chamber's mass is halved with floor, the removed part goes to waste, and the cycle is recorded.
table.ruleB: 1-norm after Step 4; if it is strictly more than 38, every x_i becomes floor(x_i/2), the removed part goes to s, and the iteration is recorded.

table.ruleA: End masses 1-6, end stages, stage-change list (cycle, chamber, before, after), moult cycles, waste tally, balance check.
table.ruleB: End values 1-6, end flags, flag-change list (iteration, component, before, after), penalty iterations, s, balance check.
